title: Modular 26.4: SOTA MoE serving, model bringup via agent skills, Mojo 1.0 beta 2 and more
gist: Published skills let a coding agent port a new model into Modular's engine: inspect the config, scaffold from the nearest existing architecture, then chase layer-by-layer divergence against the reference until the outputs match. The kernels underneath stay human-written. Qualcomm acquired the company weeks later.
changes: Agents doing day-zero model support, which is the churn problem, with a correctness oracle that is easy to state. Also a sign of where independent compiler companies end up: inside a chip vendor.
caveats: No bring-up times, speed-ups or baselines. One demonstration model. Acquisition terms are undisclosed.

bears_on.note: Model bring-up is being handed to agents because there are too many models.
This is porting against an exact oracle, not optimisation. The kernels are still written by people.
